_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. glassnode.com's public surfaces are five stacks: the marketing site's --base_*/--light_* layer (palette.* and light.theme.*), the studio shell's declared --gds-* design system in light and dark scopes (light.studio.* and dark.studio.* — the dark scope is declared but has no public theme control, so it is labelled declared-not-painted), the Ghost research publication's --rf-* roles in both painted themes (light.research.* and dark.research.*), the tokenization registry's --color-* roles (dark.tokenization.* painted by default, light.tokenization.* via the theme button), and the type/space/radius/shadow/layout scales under core.*. The GitBook docs stack stays outside the token tree; its measured values are component.docs.*. Measured roles alias the declared values they match.
